home.name: Raphael Scharf Passos
home.phrase: I build back-ends in C# and Python, and I like turning manual work into systems.
home.status: Looking for an IT internship: afternoons, on-site or hybrid in Curitiba, or remote.

unicar.name: UniCar
unicar.description: Carpooling app for university students in Curitiba. API with JWT login and college e-mail verification, real-time driver location and chat, routes and pricing with Google Maps, and integration tests.

frotas.name: Fleet Automation
frotas.description: Internal system for an insurance brokerage in Curitiba: it reads fleet policies in PDF from several insurers, extracts the vehicles and generates a standardized Excel file, with pending-item review, history and versions.

about.title: About me
about.aboutText: I live in Curitiba and study in the mornings. I like understanding how an operation works on the inside and cutting out its repetitive work.
about.educationUni: Software Engineering, Universidade Positivo, 2nd year, expected graduation in 2028.
about.educationTech: Technical degree in Systems Analysis and Development, SENAI, 2024.
about.experienceSupport: Freelance technical support at Biobanco (2024–2025): computer maintenance, hardware and software troubleshooting, and support for the lab's users.
about.langEn: English, basic, studying for the Cambridge exam
